name: alu_forms
mechanisms: instruction.service issue_interval_cycles of the integer classes bound to alu_smsp / fmaheavy_smsp (IADD3, LOP3, SHF, IMAD)
ownership: cluster-local; no commit of the other lines on these leaves since main 83ad9681.
question: How many cycles per instruction does an SMSP need for independent integer instructions as a function of the number of warps on it (1, 2, 4, 8) and of the instruction's register-source form?
why: flashinfer_segment_03 (H100 full GPU, sim / ncu 1.29; grid 8192, 16 warps per SMSP, about 100 instructions per warp): the simulation spends 1229 cycles per warp waiting for units (IADD3 / LOP3 / PRMT / ISETP / VIADD on alu_smsp, issue interval 2.0 from service_latency's one-warp throughput cell), the hardware finishes a warp in 1560 cycles of which 794 are the wait for load data: more than one integer instruction per cycle and SMSP. The ifetch bodies (add.u32 r, r, 1) run at 1.00 cycle per instruction for one warp.
probe: probe/alu_forms.cu: kinds add_imm, add_rr, add_rrr, xor_rr, and_imm, mad_rrr, add_rs, shl_imm on eight independent registers; W = 1, 2, 4, 8 warps per SMSP; U = 64 / 128 / 256; --launches 16 --reps 65, two runs.
derivation: OLS slope of the median window over U per (kind, W), per-warp window and CTA window; SMSP cycles per instruction = CTA slope / W.
prediction_of_the_installed_model: alu_smsp classes (IADD3 2.011, LOP3 2.006, SHF as installed) and IMAD (2.006 on fmaheavy_smsp): CTA slope = interval x W for every source form, i.e. 2.0 / 4.0 / 8.0 / 16.0 at W = 1 / 2 / 4 / 8; forms with three distinct sources not below the operand-read rule (1.5 per instruction and warp).

reading.usable: OLS residual <= 2 %, runs within 3 %; SASS: the window is U instructions of one opcode class, listed with operand forms and reuse flags.
reading.R1: every kind within 10 % of interval x W -> the installed intervals hold with several warps; the flashinfer excess is elsewhere.
reading.R2: otherwise the table (kind, W) is the result; a rule (interval by source form, or an issue-slot bound instead of a unit) is proposed in an addendum (post hoc) and judged on kinds its constants do not come from.

not_allowed: no value from full-GPU error; no per-kernel rule.

addenda.reading_of_run_1: ptxas folded the kinds whose repeated operation on one register combines: add_imm, xor_rr, and_imm, shl_imm became 8 instructions per window (slope 0) and add_rr / add_rs 32 IADD3 with the source doubled; on b300 add_rrr was folded as well. What survived: h100 add_rrr (64 IADD3 with three distinct sources) 2.00 / 3.99 / 8.14 / 16.01 cycles per instruction at W = 1 / 2 / 4 / 8, mad_rrr (64 IMAD) 2.04 / 4.04 / 8.08 / 16.11 (b300 2.00 / 4.00 / 8.03 / 16.04), add_rr / add_rs 2.0 x W per remaining instruction on both devices. R1 holds for the forms with two or three register sources; the one-source forms were not measured.

run_2.kinds (probe addition; visit j = I >> 3: imm_ax: even j add.u32 d, d, 1, odd j xor.b32 d, d, 85; rr_ax: even j add.u32 d, d, a[k], odd j xor.b32 d, d, b[k]; imm_as: even j add.u32 d, d, 1, odd j shl.b32 d, d, 1.
run_2.prediction_of_the_installed_model: 2.0 x W per instruction for all three kinds (IADD3 / VIADD / LOP3 / SHF on alu_smsp).
run_2.reading: SASS first: the window must hold U instructions (else the kind is void). R1 as before. If the one-source kinds are at 1.0 x W while rr_ax is at 2.0 x W, the interval of these classes depends on the number of register sources (one source: one per cycle) and that table is the result; the rule is then proposed in a further addendum.

reading_of_run_2 (CTA window, cycles per.imm_ax: window = 32 VIADD r, r, imm + 32 LOP3.LUT r, r, imm (one register source each): h100 1.02 / 2.04 / 4.08 / 8.27, b300 1.03 / 2.00 / 4.00 / 8.01 -> 1.0 x W; the installed model gives 2.0 x W. R1 fails for one-source forms.
reading_of_run_2 (CTA window, cycles per.imm_as: folded by ptxas to 16 VIADD + 16 LEA (U = 64): per remaining instruction 1.04 / 2.07 / 4.10 / 8.35 (h100), 1.07 / 2.00 / 4.00 / 8.01 (b300) -> 1.0 x W.
reading_of_run_2 (CTA window, cycles per.rr_ax: window = 30-31 IMAD.IADD r, r2, 0x1, r3 + 32 LOP3.LUT with two register sources: h100 1.54 / 2.59 / 4.90 / 9.63, b300 1.63 / 2.79 / 5.14 / 10.1 -> about 1.25 x W from two warps on; two classes on two units, not separable.
reading_of_run_2 (CTA window, cycles per.with run 1: three register sources (IADD3, IMAD) and IADD3 with a repeated source: 2.0 x W.

addenda.rule (post hoc): an instruction of VIADD, LOP3 or LEA that reads at most one general-purpose register occupies its SMSP unit for one cycle. The class intervals stay for the other forms.
addenda.installed: instruction.service field single_source_issue_interval_cycles = 1.0 on the VIADD, LOP3 and LEA leaves of both devices (experimental). Not installed: two-source forms (about 1.25 measured for a two-class mix against 2.0), other classes of the same unit with one source (ISETP, SHF, PRMT, IADD3 with an immediate were folded or not in the windows).
addenda.not_allowed_reminder: no value was chosen by case error.
